verdict.rationale: Warp's open-source announcement says it is shipping a long-overdue settings file for programmatic control and easy portability between devices, which supports keeping settings in dotfiles and syncing them. That is a single blog-level mention: there is no documentation of the file's format or location, or whether it covers the full configuration. Missing for 10: documented plain-text format and path for the settings file, evidence it covers all configuration (themes, keybindings, etc.), a documented dotfiles/multi-machine sync workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
